disposition_reason: Prints mean, min and max for six metals in 10 locally made processed cheeses and 20 emulsifying salt samples from Baghdad.

study.design: Market survey of locally made processed cheese and the emulsifying salts used to make it
study.method: Wet acid digestion (6N HCl; HNO3 for salts after ashing at 450 °C) and AAS (Varian AA375, Perkin-Elmer)
study.lod_text: not stated; cheese results printed as <0.1 ppm (Cd, Mn) and <0.05 ppm (Pb)
study.qa: Calibration standards 0.01-0.04; no CRM or recovery reported
